name: india-property-tycoon
description: Real-time multiplayer India-themed property trading game (React + Node + Socket.IO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
